names.note: Read out of the life doxologia.ro prints for 29 aprilie under the line «Sfinții 9 Mucenici din Cizic», which names the nine: «Teognid, Ruf, Antipatru, Teostih, Artema, Magn, Teodot, Tavmasie și Filimon».
Read out of saint.gr's heading on the page of «Άγιοι Εννέα Μάρτυρες εν Κυζίκω», «Άγιος Θεόγνις Μάρτυρας Εν Κυζίκω», with the rank word and the place left off.

Read out of the body of the Охридски пролог's entry for 29. април ст. ст., out of the naming clause „Имена су њихова Теогоније, Руф, Антипатер, Теостих, Артем, Магн, Теодот, Тавмасије и Филимон.“ — a bare list with no rank word on any of them and no epithet; the heading names nobody, so there is no heading form to take, and Cyzicus, which this corpus's English name keeps, is in the heading and not in the list. The book prints Теогоније, where the Greek gives Θεόγνις and doxologia Teognid; a copied script form is never corrected by a reader, so it is stored exactly as printed although it is the furthest of the nine from the Greek.

attestations.note: Not checked: days.pravoslavie.ru for the corresponding Julian day (20 September 2026).

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 29 aprilie — «Sfinții 9 Mucenici din Cizic»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 28ης Απριλίου — «Άγιοι Εννέα Μάρτυρες εν Κυζίκω»

attestations.note: The life page is one entry for all nine and heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 28 Απριλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing — **a day earlier than the 29 April the Romanian row on this folder already carries**, which is the Greek calendar's own reckoning of the same company and not a correction of it. It is plainly the same nine: the day's line is «Άγιοι Εννέα Μάρτυρες εν Κυζίκω», the page's own list names Theognis, Rufus, Antipater, Theostichus, Artemas, Magnus, Theodotus, Thaumasius and Philemon, and it has them from different places, seized together at Cyzicus, imprisoned without water or bread, and beheaded on the governor's order. The Greek adds an apolytikion of the nine, which the Romanian source did not print and which is stored here; it gives no year and no emperor, so this folder's empty `dates` were left empty, and it names no relic, where the Romanian life has the finding of the nine bodies under Constantine. The paragraph saint.gr prints under his name, about a considerable lyric poet from Megara who lived from 560 to 500 before Christ, is its gloss on the name Θεόγνις and is not about the martyr.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 12.05.2026 (29. април ст. ст.) — „Св. Девет мученика у Кизику.“

attestations.note: **The heading names nobody — „Св. Девет мученика у Кизику.“ counts them and stops — and the body is where this book names them**, so the citation above is that heading whole, per BRIEF-SERBIAN.md §4 and the coordinator's ruling for a heading that enumerates its members in the body. The body's own naming clause is „Имена су њихова Теогоније, Руф, Антипатер, Теостих, Артем, Магн, Теодот, Тавмасије и Филимон.“ — nine names, in the same order as doxologia's long life and as saint.gr's notice, with the same city, the same refusal, the same beheading and the same incorrupt relics, so they are the same nine. **The form is the furthest of the nine from the Greek** — Теогоније against Θεόγνις — and is stored as printed. He is first in this list as he is first in both of the others', which is part of the identification. **A first date**: „Чесно пострадаше и прославише се у III веку“ → `death` 201–300, `display: "3rd century"`, `traditional`, where doxologia says only that it happened before Constantine's reign and saint.gr gives no year and names no emperor. `node .tmp/dd.mjs "3rd century"` reads «III в.» and «3ος αι.» New besides: that the church at Cyzicus was built **in the emperor Constantine's own time** and that the relics were laid in it — doxologia has the Christians of the city raise it after the persecution ceased, without putting it in the reign — and the sentence about despising the temporal for the eternal. The Prologue prints no hymn; saint.gr's apolytikion of the nine together was taken by neither reading.

hymns.text: Θείας πίστεως, τὴ συμφωνία, ἐννεάριθμος, Μαρτύρων δῆμος, ἐν Κυζίκῳ ἱερῶς ἠνδραγάθησε, τὸν γὰρ Ὑπέρθεον Λόγον κηρύξαντες, ὑπὲρ αὐτοῦ ὡς ἀμνοὶ σφαγιάζονται, ὅθεν ἄφεσιν, αἰτοῦνται ἠμὶν καὶ ἔλεος, τοὶς μέλπουσιν αὐτῶν τὴν θείαν ἄθλησιν.

source.text: saint.gr, Ἀπολυτίκιον (Κατέβασμα), Ἦχος γ', Θείας πίστεως, on the page of «Άγιοι Εννέα Μάρτυρες εν Κυζίκω»

english.text: By the concord of divine faith the nine-numbered company of martyrs did valiantly and in holy fashion at Cyzicus; for having preached the supremely divine Word, they are slaughtered like lambs for His sake. Wherefore they ask forgiveness and mercy for us who sing their divine contest.

death.note: The Охридски пролог for 29. април ст. ст.: „Чесно пострадаше и прославише се у III веку.“ — the first century any calendar read for these nine has given. doxologia's life places the martyrdom only before the reign of Constantine the Great, which the third century satisfies, and saint.gr gives no year and names no emperor.
